I'm an Arabian I've suffered of mild depression for almost a year specifically since a broke up with my girlfriend. I tried a lot of antidepressants but never seemed to work good accept Venlafaxine and imipramine but still can't feel normal yet. I heard about American people and how they can make a powerful stimulate called methamphetamine that synthesized easily from a legal substance  called ephedrine then I checked out peoples exeperance on it to see.
I found out that it has very bad comedown include being highly addictive. So I decided to find another stimulant that weaker than methamphetamine. Then I heard about methacathinone aka (the arabian cocaine) which also can be synthesized from ephedrine too. After a lot of thinking I decided to synthesis it in my own house.
We started off added 3 gram of pesudoephedrine sulfate or (hcl) in 200 ml diluted water then added 5ml hcl 33%. Then I put it in the microwave to get boiled for 15 min then added 5ml hydrogen proxide 33% to the solution. Then I boiled it for half hour in the microwave. Then I let the solution dry by putting it on glas dish (it's size 70x100) in my room. The next day I found it dried at all so I scraped the powder from the dish and put it. In a cup then added 200 ml diethyl ether to it and washed it three times (pesudoehpedrine hcl won't dissolve in ether) to take the hydrogen peroxide out (it will be soluble in ether unlike methcathinone) then dry the powder till it became soft.
I took 100 mg of it and put it under my I waited for 10 min and wow I felt calm and peaceful and kind of sleepiness. It stayed for three hours then the effect starting wearing off with no comedown. It was a nice trip but I still worry about the long term effect I guess I'm gonna use it carefully.
